start.text: You close your hand round the taper. It hums the way a Remnant hums, and what it hums is yours.
Cold stone under your feet, turning always to the left. Your thumb finds a notch: a landing. Then another.
Under somebody's breath, the landings are being counted. You can't tell whose breath it is.
Somebody a turn above you holds a light that isn't a candle, and says a name, and you know the name is yours, and it doesn't come.
You hold on past where it let go of you in the Vigil Light's smoke. The stair goes on turning. The name doesn't come.
Then it's a candle-end in your hand again, notched, burned down past the third landing.
Then it's a candle-end in your hand again, notched, cold at the wick.
